articles.headline: James Harden ends slow start with season-high 32 points to lead Cavs past Knicks
articles.description: After coming into Wednesday night averaging just 15.3 points through 11 games, James Harden turned in a throwback performance with a season-high 32 points to lead the Cavaliers to a 115-107 victory over the Knicks.

images.name: James Harden  [600x400]
images.caption: "It’s my 18th year, so my name is James Harden, and I used to score a lot of points," James Harden said Wednesday. "Still score points, but try to find out other ways to impact the game as well. And I think that’s what people probably don’t understand."

articles.headline: Bulls rookie Caleb Wilson leaves loss to Spurs with right hand injury
articles.description: Bulls first-round pick Caleb Wilson injured his right hand in the third quarter quarter of Wednesday's loss to the Spurs and did not finish the game.

articles.headline: Egor Demin scores 22 in his return as the Nets rout the Pelicans 145-111
articles.description: — Egor Demin returned from a six-game injury absence to score 22 points, Michael Porter Jr. also scored 22, and the Brooklyn Nets beat New Orleans 145-111 on Wednesday night, handing the Pelicans their fourth consecutive loss.
